meta.title: Add debounce to pyplot example Randomize button
meta.body_summary: Add debounce to the Randomize button in the pyplot example to reduce processing lag, using a 1.2-second debounce on the button's on_click handler.

perf_labels.notes: Devin PR adding a .debounce(1200) to a pyplot example button was closed by the bot immediately with no human review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2 changed lines in a single file, this is a minimal one-liner edit. As a small performance PR it was closed without merge—no maintainer engagement occurred and the bot closed the PR nearly instantly.
